title: AttributeError in escape_inline_json when non-string value is provided
body: The `escape_inline_json` function in `pyxle/ssr/_escape.py` assumes the input is a string and calls `.replace()` directly on it. Passing a non-string value (such as an integer like `123`) results in an `AttributeError`. While it's primarily used internally where inputs are expected to be strings, it lacks explicit type checking or conversion, making it fragile.
